title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE TE KOMUNA E PARISIT (LULISHTJA)
description_sq:
Ne zonen e komunes se parisit prane lulishtes ofrojme per shitje apartament te tipologjise 2+1.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 2 ne nje nga kullat tek pallatet e Arabit ndertim i viteve 2000.
Me siperfaqe 100 m2 neto perbehet si me poshte:
- Korridor 
- Sallon mjaft i bollshem
-Kuzhine totalisht e vecuar
-2 dhoma gjumi
-Tualet
-Ballkon
Apartamenti ka orientim jug-lindje.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe mund te shitet dhe me kredi.
title_en: APARTMENT 2+1 FOR SALE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS (LULISHTJA)
description_en: In the area of ​​the municipality of Paris, near the flower garden, we offer for sale a 2+1 typology apartment. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor in one of the towers of the Arab palaces, built in the 2000s. With a net area of ​​100 m2, it consists of the following: - Corridor - Spacious living room - Fully separate kitchen - 2 bedrooms - Toilets - Balcony The apartment has a south-east orientation. It has regular mortgage documentation and can be sold on credit.
